analysis.one_line_summary: Receipt-style Black Friday promotional graphic offering 35% off the Wavytalk Whirlwind Curl Airflow Styler and Straightener at $71.10.
analysis.full_description: A square static promotional ad formatted as a printed white receipt against a textured dark purple/maroon background. The receipt header features the Wavytalk logo, 'Black Friday', and the discounted price and deal: '$71.10 | 35% OFF'. The receipt body lists the line item 'WHIRLWIND CURL Airflow Styler and Straightener' with a quantity of 1, accompanied by a high-resolution vertical cutout of the light pink airflow styler device. A dark purple circular sticker on the right reads 'TODAY ONLY'. Portions of other paper receipts and barcodes peek in from the corners.

scenes.visual: A graphic design composition showing a white paper receipt on a dark wine-red textured background with barcode slips on the left and another receipt corner on the bottom right. In the center of the receipt sits a studio cutout of the pale pink Wavytalk Whirlwind Curl Airflow Styler and Straightener, with a 'TODAY ONLY' circular badge to its right.
